items.why_en: Significantly improves the speed and quality of humanoid auto-rigging and optimizes retargeting.

items.name: Tripo P2.0

items.why_en: Industry's first native quad topology generation model, significantly enhancing production readiness for game assets.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio Object Keyframing

items.why_en: Enables keyframe animation for static objects within the 3D Editor, increasing animation control.

items.name: Meshy `meshy-t2.5` AI Model Update
items.why: 提升 AI 生成遊戲資產的智能拓撲細節，為後續綁骨提供更優質的基礎模型。
items.why_en: Enhances smart topology details for AI-generated game assets, providing a better foundation model for subsequent rigging.
